title: Typed Resource Catalog (TRC)
description: TRC's memory: a typed addressing system whose paths are categorical identities under the Yoneda embedding of the POSIX path category. Every typed resource at <catalog-root>/<...>/<thing>/ has three co-located parts — a JSON Schema realizing a cellular fiber (the predication fiber algebra A_p = (L × L)^(E × E) at that thing's predicate coordinate, or the subject-anchored slice at that thing's entity coordinate), a per-thing JSONL log holding the entity-pair assignments inhabiting that fiber, and (for morphism resources) an ESM script realizing a knowledge-monotone closure rule. Per-thing logs are dually filed at the subject and predicate anchors of every row by force of Yoneda computability. The catalog instance carries only the catalog-root; the catalog's contents are the per-thing things at the per-thing paths beneath that root. Full normative specification at docs/dev/specification.md.

catalog-root.description: POSIX path to the directory beneath which every per-thing path is resolved. Each path segment beneath the root MUST be a slug matching ^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$. The path of any resource IS its categorical identity (by Yoneda applied to the path category).
